# Communes chapter, sgt1928 (ark bpt6k91056510): "Finances municipales: b) Emprunts communaux" (Tunis bond
# loans) and "c) Emprunts contractés à la Caisse des Prêts Communaux". Two-page spreads, views 588-589,
# 590-591 and 592-593 (printed pages 36-41).
# Every cell read on native-resolution crops of the page images (hires.py); Gallica OCR used as a draft and to
# locate the lines. The annuity column of the first spread runs into the binding: the centimes are squeezed
# but readable (and the Totaux line checks).
# Format: '@<table> view=<left view> view2=<right view> page=<left page> year=<exercice>', 'cols:', then
# '= <commune heading as printed>' and rows '<date of the loan as printed> | values', 'Totaux | ...' per commune.
# Money: francs with centimes after '.', no thousands separator; printed » = 0; '?' = illegible;
# 'NNN.xx' = franc part legible, centimes hidden in the binding;
# durations in years ("ans"); interest rate in percent ("3 75" = 3.75, "3 1/2" = 3.5).
# @tunis_bonds cols: columns 2-17 of the table; @caisse cols: columns 2-13 of the table.
# The heading of the "Sommes échues" columns of the Tunis bonds reads "à la fin de l'exercice 1927" (right page:
# "de 1928", "jusqu'à la fin de 1928", "à la clôture de l'exercice 1928").
@tunis_bonds view=588 view2=589 page=36 year=1928
cols: dur rate cap_net cap_nom int_due cap_due int_paid_year cap_paid_year int_paid_before cap_paid_before int_paid_total cap_paid_total int_lapsed cap_lapsed int_outstanding cap_outstanding
